serverInfo.name: io.github.kwizzlesurp10-ctrl/x402-mcp
serverInfo.title: CivicPulse 402 Municipal Compliance Gateway
serverInfo.description: Real-time Minneapolis housing code violations, building permits, and Ramsey County parcel GIS audits via Base USDC ($0.01) x402.

tools.name: query_minneapolis_compliance
tools.description: Fetches real-time City of Minneapolis housing code violations, active repair orders, and building permits for a street address via ArcGIS Open Data. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

address.description: Minneapolis street address (e.g., '1700 Penn Ave N')

httpStatus.description: Upstream compliance HTTP status code (200 or 402).

wwwAuthenticate.description: RFC 7235 x402 challenge header when unpaid.

paymentRequired.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge when unpaid.

violations.description: Active and historical Minneapolis housing code violations.

permits.description: Associated Minneapolis building and repair permits.

tools.name: query_ramsey_parcel_audit
tools.description: Queries Ramsey County Open GIS for parcel attributes, registered owner, property use class, and tax assessment valuation by PIN or site address. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

httpStatus.description: Upstream GIS audit HTTP status code (200 or 402).

wwwAuthenticate.description: RFC 7235 x402 challenge header when unpaid.

paymentRequired.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge when unpaid.

parcel.description: Ramsey County parcel attributes, owner, and tax valuation.

parcel_id.description: Queried Ramsey County PIN or street address.
